assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only chiramune:asuka-nishino@light-novel#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional generation V1.2 cumulative monograph CHIRAMUNE_ASUKA_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese light novels: main Volumes 01-09 and every admitted narrative supplement it integrates through Volume 09.5 (the V05 special-edition booklet, V06.5, Days of Endless Summer and Volume 09.5). The V08 rough-illustration collection is excluded by the monograph as production paratext. V01-V02 enter only as Saku's and Yuzuki's witness; V04 and Volume 09.5 supply no Asuka focalization. The Chiramune readings, longitudinal ledgers, specialist syntheses and other character monographs that also analyze Asuka are not curated on this subject and were not used. The monograph's active_provisional status and its own current-model statements are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The base model is the V03 promotion model (direct childhood focalization in chapter 4, family conflict, the Tokyo trip and decision, with paragraph-range locators), followed by located revisions for V04 (no Asuka focalization; Saku's category reopened), V05 main, the V05 special edition (including a V02-associated riverside scene placed before V03), V06, V06.5, V07, V08 main, V09, Days of Endless Summer and Volume 09.5 (family and institutional context only, no new Asuka state). The monograph's sections are not in reading order (V09 and Days of Endless Summer precede V08 main, V06.5 and V07), and its opening scope paragraph still calls it V04-bounded while the front matter and later sections extend to Volume 09.5; each section's current model is bound to its own boundary. Her childhood summers with Saku are her knowledge at every state; Saku learns her childhood identity only at V03 p-0032. Later states never revise earlier located behavior.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A governing account (section 1: freedom learned relationally from child Saku, practiced until it became hers, doubted because its first grammar was borrowed, with the risk that independence becomes another role that forbids need), a stable-versus-state split (section 13), a care style with named failure modes (section 11) and rejected rival readings (section 14). It says what changes her response: when someone would take decision authority over her future she refuses the transfer while making her dependence visible (father and Saku, V03 p-0032 p0643-p0676); support that leaves authorship with her is accepted (Kuranosuke, V03 p-0022 p0197-p0250; her father's practical help, V065 p-0021 p0039-p0141; Yua's instruction, V09 p-0022 p0782-p0934); when she believes she has failed the Asuka-nee role she withdraws to spare Saku (V03 p-0022 p0323-p0375); finite time turns into deliberate present action (V05 part0008 to part0010, V05S p-0069). It predicts her mistakes: authoring renunciation as her own decision under refusal (section 7), poorly planned Tokyo risk, the reciprocal-proof debt (section 11), suppressing her own stake to keep the moon role clean (V06 p-0020 p0419-p0428), the riverbank panic (V07 part0020 p0162-p0418) and interpretive fluency that overwrites an interviewee (V065 p-0021 p0720-p0831). It stops at reliance in Tokyo and at self-originated requests to Saku for finite company, which every watchlist leaves open.

Each revision ends in a bounded current model with locators, and the account says what changes between states and why: V03 compliance-as-own-decision, then research, argument and refusal of guardianship; V04 Saku-side category reopened (p-0015 p0130-p0166) without retracting her named love; V05 main finite summer as deliberate practice; V05 special-edition earlier finitude and the escape morning (V05S p-0049, p-0063); V06 asking not to be shut out of Saku's pain and the grandmother's bond model (V06 p-0014, p-0020); V06.5 first editorial failure corrected into listening (V065 p-0021, p-0023); V07 riverbank outburst, apology and friendship with Yua (part0019 to part0022); V08 lateral responsibility within the group (V08 p-0016, p-0018); V09 group repair and borrowed-but-authored cooking; Days of Endless Summer refusal of Okuno and a lateral alliance with Momiji (DES p-0022, p-0078); Volume 09.5 context only. Limits: V01-V02 are witness only, V04 and Volume 09.5 add no Asuka decision, and sections are out of reading order.

There is no voice or register section. The monograph describes recurring verbal practice located across states: poetic reframing and metaphor (the 'park', moon and marble language, many-moons epilogue), the Asuka-nee senior mode of invitation and rule-bending (V03 p-0032 p0291-p0343), teasing and sexual playfulness, temporary same-age names (V05 main), a shift to closer address with Yua (V07 part0019), direct challenge to Saku's claim to know her desire, and demands for heart-level disclosure (V06 p-0020 p0263-p0417). Attested forms are few (`朔兄`, Asuka-nee, the left-ear signal). Pronouns, address inventory, sentence endings and register shifts are not described.

Section 10 gives a bounded V03 ordinary-life profile (extensive reading, inexperience with billiards, dates and travel because of family restriction, playful and awkward without losing poise, attachment to river, trains and town, the left-ear code, the turquoise earbuds gift, entry into the peer group through teasing), extended by located scenes: V05 local adventure, study and childhood-linked food (omusubi, simmered takuan, rural train; part0008 p0438-p0544), V06 Obon practice at her grandmother's house (p-0020 p0072-p0259), V08 a planned market outing with Yua, and V09 her first omurice learned from Yua. It is a trait list plus scenes rather than an account of how routines adapt; daily home routine and schoolwork are thin, and Tokyo life is never sampled.

Relations are differentiated and located, and the account says what each changes: Saku (reciprocal formation, idealization and demystification, love named at V03 p-0032 p0348-p0412, authorization and violation, refusal of his guardianship, V04 reopened category, V06 asked-for access, V06.5 the room he leaves for her disclosure, V07 riverbank harm); her father (unilateral refusal, slap, ultimatum and stress test, then admission and permission at V03 p-0032 p0689-p0763, practical support without decision authority at V065 p-0021, Volume 09.5 context); Kuranosuke as provisional adult ally; Yuzuki (V02 witness, DES p-0057 asymmetry of understanding); Yua (V07 friendship, V08 reciprocal correction, V09 instruction); Momiji (V07 harm and apology, V09 group repair, DES lateral alliance); Haru (V05S p-0069 jealousy without sabotage); her grandmother (bond model); the URALA editor, Hirayama and Suzuki (correction); Okuno (clean refusal). The monograph explicitly declines a detailed model of her mother, and direct Asuka/Momiji dyadic repair is absent.

Interior content is located at several boundaries and causally drives located choices: V03 chapter 4 childhood focalization and present self-accusation of imitation (p-0032), the V05 special-edition escape-morning relief and preparation (V05S p-0063 p0003-p0014, p0043-p0052), grief at seeing Saku's baseball and the decision to enter anyway (V05S p-0069 p0017-p0057), fear that one romantic failure could end the bond (V06 p-0014 p0212-p0301), the private line that a crooked heart cannot be his moon (V06 p-0020 p0419-p0428), recognized disproportionate jealousy (V07 part0020) and the V08 conclusion about other women's tears (p-0018 p0104-p0221). The monograph treats memory as privileged autobiographical evidence, not access to Saku's mind; V04 and Volume 09.5 have no Asuka focalization.

Located responses fall into conditioned families: under family refusal she first authors compliance, then researches, returns, argues a concrete case and keeps speaking under an estrangement ultimatum (sections 7 and 9); against a would-be guardian she refuses transfer and claims the risk (V03 p-0032 p0643-p0676); against Saku's claim to know her desire she contests it directly; after perceived role failure she withdraws (V03 p-0022 p0323-p0375); against a threat to an exclusive-feeling place she shouts, flees and apologizes the next day (V07 part0020 to part0022 p0096-p0124); under editorial correction she accepts it without surrendering Tokyo (V065 p-0023 p0413-p0440); with Yua she exchanges correction (V08 p-0016 to p-0018); against an unwanted suitor she refuses cleanly (DES p-0022 p0027-p0058); in rivalry with Haru she reasserts her own last page without sabotage. Conflict with adult authority beyond her father and the editors, and a direct boundary conversation with Momiji, are not sampled.

Located positions with their corrections: dependence made visible does not concede decision authority (section 7); a beloved's guarantee is not a right to decide her future (V03 p-0032); interpretation must not make another person speak her words (V065 p-0021 p0720-p0831); choosing a nearby approximation mainly to stay near Saku would be her compromise (V065 p-0023 p0413-p0440); a shared place or person is not property, and group membership creates duties toward the other women (V08 p-0016 to p-0018); her father's critique is accepted without ceding the choice (DES p-0044). The non-ownership principle organizes these, and some weighing is rendered (the V06.5 Tokyo retention, the V08 conclusion), but her own V06 withholding of her romantic stake is not deliberated, and dilemmas outside authorship, possession and listening are not sampled.

Play is distributed and located: awkward games and sexual playfulness in V03 (section 10), the near-kiss turned into play and temporary same-age names (V05 main), teasing about possible marriage over a shared earbud (V05S p-0049 p0025-p0035), and entry into the peer group through teasing and rivalry. Humor content, style and the conditions that switch play to seriousness are not analyzed.

One cumulative monograph covers main V01-V09 and every admitted supplement through Volume 09.5, with a V03 base model and paragraph-range locators for most claims. Gaps: V01-V02 are witness only, V04 and Volume 09.5 contribute no Asuka focalization, there is no voice section, her mother is explicitly unreconstructed, sections are out of order and the opening scope sentence still reads V04-bounded, and generation V1.2 is active_provisional. The readings, ledgers and syntheses that also analyze Asuka are not curated on this subject.

Affirmative limits are located: five rival readings are rejected or narrowed (section 14), including 'only Saku's ideal woman' and 'mutual love resolves the relationship'; Saku's V04 uncertainty narrows the relation from settled mutual love (p-0015 p0130-p0166); no couple, exclusivity or selection forms at any boundary; the V05 beach scene does not identify her as Saku's unnamed girl; no housing, transport, study, work, placement or communication plan exists at any boundary; V09 shows group-level repair with Momiji but no dyadic process; the childhood escape is marked unsafe and not a template of ideal autonomy; Volume 09.5 explicitly adds no Asuka decision. All rest on one secondary artifact.

Each revision binds its current model to a named boundary with locators; the monograph places the V02-associated special-edition scene before V03, separates retrospective context (Volume 09.5 father's history, Days of Endless Summer placement of the V05 closing ceremony) from current transition, and forbids retrojection (later difficulty is not proof her father was entitled to decide). A reader must reorder the out-of-sequence sections and discount the stale V04-bounded scope sentence.

scenario_readiness.note: Only recurring verbal practices and a handful of attested forms are described; pronouns, address, endings and register are not. Generated lines would rest on situational description rather than a specified voice, which does not constrain output enough even for illustrative use. This bounds the evidence set, not Asuka's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named boundary state: V03 (split at the Tokyo trip between pre-trip compliance and withdrawal at p-0022 and the post-return argued decision at p-0032), V05 main, V06, V06.5, V07 (split between the riverbank outburst at part0020 and the apology at part0022), V08 main, V09 or post-Days of Endless Summer; default post-Days of Endless Summer, which Volume 09.5 leaves unchanged. Earlier states do not import later corrections, such as V06.5 listening or V08 lateral responsibility.
Her childhood summers with Saku are her knowledge at every state; before V03 p-0032 Saku does not know her childhood identity.

The interlocutor is Saku, her father, Kuranosuke, Yua, Momiji, Haru, Yuzuki, her grandmother, the located editors or Okuno. Her mother is not modeled; transfer to an unsampled peer or adult is a separate, lower-confidence condition handled without invented history.

The situation is a decision about her future under family or partner pressure, editorial or interview practice, group membership and repair, finite shared time before departure, or a threat to a place or relation she treats as special.
Reliance on others in Tokyo, a self-originated request to Saku for finite company, Saku's selection and any couple form are output as open forks, never resolved.
Output is behavioral description, not quoted dialogue.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named monograph boundary state, defaulting to post-Days of Endless Summer; earlier states only when selected, without importing later development; Volume 09.5 and Days of Endless Summer retrospective material are context, not later states.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Saku as childhood formative partner, admired junior and unanswered beloved; her father as overreaching then supporting parent; Kuranosuke as provisional adult ally; Yua and Momiji as friend and repaired rival-ally; Haru and Yuzuki as rivals; editors as correcting mentors; an unsampled peer or adult only at lower confidence.
setting_constraints: Fukui high-school and family life, local travel and the Tokyo research trip as located
Pre-vocational editorial practice: observation, practice interviews and mediation
No Tokyo residence, university, employment or editorial placement
No selection, couple status or Saku-side romantic declaration
Reliance and finite-request forks end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Readiness is conditional on one named state, a sampled relationship and the family, vocational, group and romantic settings the monograph locates. Reliance in Tokyo, self-originated finite requests to Saku and any romantic outcome stay open.

conditions: Reading, local food and travel, group outings, the market outing and cooking learned from Yua, and peer-group teasing, using the section 10 profile and the located V05, V06, V08 and V09 scenes.
The left-ear code, the riverbank and the roof carry meaning as shared history, never as ownership.
Daily home routine, schoolwork detail and Tokyo life are not invented.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary life is located but thinner than her family, vocational and relational conduct.

conditions: Restricted to the located positions: dependence versus decision authority, guarantees versus ownership, interpretation versus another's expression, compromise of destination for proximity, non-possession of places and people, and lateral duties within the group.
Each position is used at its own boundary state; the pre-V06.5 fluent overreach and the pre-V08 outsider stance remain available when those states are selected.
A novel moral dilemma outside these positions is output as an open fork.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported only for restating located positions in closely analogous situations.

conditions: Her side only: love named at V03, the deliberate V05 beach reveal, the V06 withheld stake to remain his moon, the V07 riverbank reliance, and the Days of Endless Summer refusal of Okuno because she loves Saku.
Saku's side is limited to his located attraction, prior love language and V04 categorical uncertainty; no matching current love, selection, exclusivity or couple is invented at any boundary.
She is never made the unnamed girl of Saku's later refusal.
scenario_readiness.note: Her side of the romantic relation is extensively located; its outcome is not.

conditions: Pre-vocational editorial practice only: observing a Tokyo editor (V03 p-0029 p0507-p0558), the failed URALA practice interview and its correction (V065 p-0021), the local editors' methods (V065 p-0023), studying the failed interview and mediating a child's reading at AKUSHU (DES p-0044, p-0050).
Listening after correction is used only from V06.5 on; earlier states may overwrite the speaker.
University study, employment, editorial placement, hierarchy and career outcomes are not modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Pre-vocational editorial practice is located and corrected; institutional work is not sampled.

known_limits.statement: At every boundary through Volume 09.5 Asuka's love is named but Saku answers with attraction, prior love language and V04 categorical uncertainty; no selection, exclusivity or couple forms, and no evidence identifies her as Saku's unnamed girl.
Through Volume 09.5 Tokyo remains a chosen direction without housing, transport, study, work, editorial placement or communication planning; her Tokyo life must not be invented.

Every watchlist from V03 to Volume 09.5 leaves open whether she can rely on others or ask Saku for finite company without reading it as failed independence; located acceptance of help is Fukui-bound and leaves authorship with her.
The monograph explicitly declines a detailed model of her mother and forbids inferring equal responsibility from her father's dominance.
V01-V02 present Asuka only through Saku's and Yuzuki's witness, which the monograph treats as evidence of their projection and her relational effect rather than her total character.
Asuka and Momiji repair at group level (V09) and form a lateral alliance (Days of Endless Summer), but no direct conversation about the riverbank or Momiji's concealed purpose is shown.
The childhood festival escape is marked liberating and unsafe; it is not a model of ideal autonomy to generalize.
No register, address inventory or speech-style analysis exists in this evidence set beyond recurring verbal practices and a few quoted forms.

The evidence is one active_provisional V1.2 monograph whose sections are out of reading order; no linked reading, ledger, synthesis or held-out validation is curated on this subject. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
